g.text: Earnings rise with age in urban Sindh, peaking at ages 55-59
Source: PSLM 2019-20. Sample: earners aged 15-64 in urban Sindh (n = 2644).
Weighting: hhweight; large markers are weighted mean earnings by 5-year age band.
Hollow markers: bands with fewer than 30 unweighted observations. Points jittered horizontally (max 0.4 years).
